title: approvals: three texts still say opening a request notifies nobody, after `approval.requested` (#22607): ADR-0043's v1 note, the automation skill's approval advice, and the QA checklist's known gap
body:
Filing class: ③ stale governed and QA text left by a landed change. It was found by the contract review of PR #22625 (`6094693196`, boundary flags 1 and 3) and by #22607's dev (`6094566317`). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021, `session_013j5gkUCpqQiti4GgPqqmnt`) at #22607's landing. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** objectstack triage, for the lane(s). Two of the three locations are governed (Tier H), and one is not, so this is at least two PRs.

## What changed
PR #22625 (#22607, `e8c6666870` on `main`) makes `openNodeRequest` publish `approval.requested` to each concrete approver on the slate a request opens on, through the single `notify()` ingress. One-tap links stay `remind()`-only. `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` was updated in that PR.

## The three texts, read on `main` at that merge
1. **`docs/adr/0043-*.md` (about `:40`–`:42`), Tier H.** In the "Issue" mechanics bullet: "(Open-time notification remains the flow author's `notify` node; templates there can adopt the same links later.)"
   - The contract review read it as a v1 scope note, not a recorded decision. The ADR's decision is its token table, which still holds. So the PR reverses nothing, but the sentence is now false.
   - Proposed: a one-line status amendment. Open-time notification is now the service's `approval.requested` topic, and one-tap links remain `remind()`-only.
2. **`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` (about `:382`–`:383`), Tier H.** "Notify from downstream nodes wired to the `approve` / `reject` edges rather than expecting the node to send mail itself."
   - The decision half is still right: notifying the submitter of the outcome is the flow's job.
   - The "node does not send" half is now wrong for the opening.
   - An agent reading it would add the very `notify` node the changeset tells authors to remove, the double-notify trap.
3. **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`, not governed.**
   - The `knownGaps` entry (about `:341`) says "opening a request notifies NOBODY … there is no approval.opened topic".
   - The `source` note (about `:394`) says the emitting topic set "has no approval.opened member".
   - Both are stale. The dated `history` row (about `:400`) stays true as history.
   - Harmless today: the fixtures drive remind and reassign.

## Ask
- Items 1 and 2: one docs-only Tier H PR. It is maintainer-approved per the governed-surface path, because both are agent-read texts that point at the same trap.
- Item 3: an ordinary docs PR, or the next checklist sweep. Remove the `knownGaps` entry, and name `approval.requested` in the `source` note.
- ⛔ No code change. ⛔ No change to ADR-0043's token decision.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues`, this repo, `approval opening notifies nobody ADR-0043 open-time notification notify node stale` → 4 hits, all closed: #21848, #21455, #21327, #17493. Each is a different question. None is this staleness.
